name: 34748 · Leesburg, FL
findings: ZIP 34748 (Leesburg) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34748 (Leesburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 17 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.
